# Bounce — account brief

## Who

Bounce runs a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world ([source](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org is usebounce, listed with the site usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is committed in usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 14 public repos and 96 followers ([source](https://github.com/usebounce))
- The iOS app has 12,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349))
- 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@usebounce-maintainer-1), top contributor to usebounce/bounce-app with 118 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@usebounce-maintainer-2), 64 commits to usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). No title, team, or location listed.
- Maintainer Three (@usebounce-maintainer-3), 22 commits to usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). No title, team, or location listed.

## Why now

usebounce/bounce-app was last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)), and the iOS app shipped 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Addressed to Maintainer One, top committer on bounce-app (Staff React Native Engineer persona).

You have 118 commits in bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)), it has an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the App Store shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). With that cadence on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)), which part of the pipeline runs in Actions and which runs on EAS? When a fix needs to reach those 12,800 rated users ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)), does it go out over the air or wait for the next store review?
